title: GPT-5 Nano became the text default
summary:
Text models got clearer defaults and sturdier configuration, while image generation gained fallback routes and more community projects joined the listings.

The `openai` model now maps to GPT-5 Nano; `openai-fast` remains on GPT-4.1 Nano. The following cleanup moved provider names and system-message support into model definitions, made failed transforms fall back to the original request, and removed legacy generator paths.

FLUX image requests try registered ComfyUI servers first, then Cloudflare Flux and Dreamshaper as fallbacks. Progress reporting follows each fallback attempt, so a change of route is visible rather than mysterious.

Creative Projects gained three image generators: a bilingual tool with prompt optimization and progress display, a React-based generator with style, quality, resolution and history controls, and CVRON AI. AI Agent Portal also joined the project listings with coding, content and canvas modes.

Public model listings now hide models marked hidden and provider-specific original names, with non-community models sorted first. Older entries were removed, `openai-large` moved to the seed tier, and the root of text.pollinations.ai now points to API documentation.
